description: This file defines methods for sending note or status messages to the AgentField server within an agent system. It includes functions for formatting, constructing, and sending HTTP POST requests containing note payloads, and relies on external configuration and context information.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Sends a progress/status message to the AgentField server asynchronously with specified message and tags.

methods.name: Notef
methods.description: Formats a message with fmt.Sprintf and then calls Note to send it to the server.

methods.name: sendNote
methods.description: Performs the actual HTTP request to send the note payload to the AgentField server, including necessary headers and context handling.
